plus.title: Go deeper into observing and astronomy
plus.intro: Learn observing techniques and work through the reasoning behind discoveries in astronomy.

features.quiz: Advanced and expert quizzes on the night sky and observing equipment
features.physics: 10 historical stories, 30 astrophysics problems, step-by-step hints and worked solutions
features.courses: 10 telescope observing missions and 6 star-hopping courses
features.records: Personal working notes, retrying mistakes and tracking solutions without hints
